relations.name: identity_message_status_v1
relations.view_sql:
SELECT d.message_id,
    d.identity_id AS recipient_identity_id,
    m.sender,
    m.created_at AS message_created_at,
    m.requires_ack,
    m.payload ->> 'subject'::text AS subject,
    d.event_id AS delivery_event_id,
    d.event_type AS delivery_event_type,
    d.outcome AS delivery_outcome,
    d.detail AS delivery_detail,
        CASE
            WHEN a.acknowledgement_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'EXPLICIT_REPLY_EVIDENCE'::text
            ELSE 'NO_EXPLICIT_REPLY_EVIDENCE'::text
        END AS reply_evidence_status,
    a.acknowledgement_id AS read_acknowledgement_id,
    a.evidence_ref,
    a.created_at AS read_evidence_created_at,
    m.source_refs,
    m.content_hash,
    m.projection_status
   FROM radar.delivery_events d
     JOIN radar.messages m ON m.message_id = d.message_id
     LEFT JOIN radar.acknowledgements a ON a.message_id = d.message_id AND a.identity_id = d.identity_id AND a.acknowledgement_type = 'READ'::text
  WHERE d.event_type = 'PROJECTED_FOR_IDENTITY'::text AND d.outcome = 'INDEXED_NOT_DELIVERED'::text AND d.identity_id IS NOT NULL;

relations.name: identity_message_status_v2
relations.view_sql:
SELECT d.message_id,
    d.identity_id AS recipient_identity_id,
    m.sender,
    m.created_at AS message_created_at,
    m.requires_ack,
    m.payload ->> 'subject'::text AS subject,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.payload ->> 'conversation_closed_by_sender'::text) = 'true'::text THEN true
            ELSE false
        END AS conversation_closed_by_sender,
    d.event_id AS delivery_event_id,
    d.event_type AS delivery_event_type,
    d.outcome AS delivery_outcome,
    d.detail AS delivery_detail,
        CASE
            WHEN a.acknowledgement_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'REPLY_EVIDENCE_PRESENT'::text
            WHEN (m.payload ->> 'conversation_closed_by_sender'::text) = 'true'::text THEN 'CLOSED_BY_ENDTHREAD'::text
            ELSE 'NO_REPLY_EVIDENCE_YET'::text
        END AS conversation_reply_state,
    a.acknowledgement_id AS read_acknowledgement_id,
    a.evidence_ref,
    a.created_at AS read_evidence_created_at,
    m.source_refs,
    m.content_hash,
    m.projection_status
   FROM radar.delivery_events d
     JOIN radar.messages m ON m.message_id = d.message_id
     LEFT JOIN radar.acknowledgements a ON a.message_id = d.message_id AND a.identity_id = d.identity_id AND a.acknowledgement_type = 'READ'::text
  WHERE d.event_type = 'PROJECTED_FOR_IDENTITY'::text AND d.outcome = 'INDEXED_NOT_DELIVERED'::text AND d.identity_id IS NOT NULL;

relations.name: open_assignments_v1
relations.view_sql:
WITH assignment_base AS (
         SELECT a.assignment_id,
            a.workflow_id,
            lower(a.current_state) AS current_state,
            a.assignee_identity_id,
            a.authority_ref,
            a.protected_authority,
            a.source_message_id,
            a.current_event_id,
            a.created_at,
            a.updated_at,
            e.event_type AS current_event_type,
            e.actor AS current_event_actor,
            e.from_state AS current_event_from_state,
            e.to_state AS current_event_to_state,
            e.predecessor_event_id,
            e.operation_id,
            e.receipt_sha256,
            e.detail AS current_event_detail,
            e.created_at AS current_event_created_at
           FROM radar.assignments a
             LEFT JOIN radar.assignment_events e ON e.event_id = a.current_event_id
        )
 SELECT assignment_id,
    workflow_id,
    current_state,
    assignee_identity_id,
    authority_ref,
    protected_authority,
    source_message_id,
    current_event_id,
    created_at,
    updated_at,
    current_event_type,
    current_event_actor,
    current_event_from_state,
    current_event_to_state,
    predecessor_event_id,
    operation_id,
    receipt_sha256,
    current_event_detail,
    current_event_created_at
   FROM assignment_base
  WHERE current_state <> ALL (ARRAY['confirmed'::text, 'stopped'::text, 'superseded'::text]);
